meta.description: Rolling-origin evaluation of the independent-Poisson model, test seasons 2016-17..2025-26. Before every Fri-Mon or Tue-Thu matchday window, refit on all earlier matches since 2005-06 with exponential time decay; team strengths per spell (consecutive PL seasons); promoted spells get a Gaussian prior (SD 0.3 on log scale) toward a rule-based target. Probabilities from the renormalised 0..10 score grid. Base rate = H/D/A frequencies over all seasons before the test season. Pinnacle 'pre-match' odds are football-data's Fri/Tue-afternoon collection (1-3 days before kick-off), not opening odds; the bookmaker knows injuries and team news the model does not. 2025-26 has Pinnacle odds for 210 of 380 matches (none after 17 Jan 2026); Pinnacle comparisons use those 210, Poisson vs base rate uses all 380.

logloss_poisson_mean10.how: rolling Poisson (hl=365d|gamma=season|promoted=relegated), refitted before every Fri-Mon / Tue-Thu window; mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

logloss_base_rate_mean10.how: H/D/A frequencies of all seasons before the test season (from 2005-06); mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

logloss_pinnacle_prematch_mean10.how: Pinnacle pre-match (Fri/Tue collection, 1-3 days before kick-off), margin removed proportionally; Pinnacle and the paired Poisson values use the 3,630 matches with odds (2025-26: 210 of 380); mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

logloss_pinnacle_closing_mean10.how: Pinnacle closing odds, margin removed proportionally; Pinnacle and the paired Poisson values use the 3,630 matches with odds (2025-26: 210 of 380); mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

logloss_poisson_on_odds_matches_mean10.how: same Poisson forecasts restricted to matches with Pinnacle odds; mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

brier_base_rate_mean10.how: multi-class Brier (0..2); mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

poisson_minus_base_logloss_mean10.how: paired difference (negative = Poisson better), all 3,800 matches; mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

poisson_minus_pinnacle_prematch_logloss_.how: paired difference (positive = Pinnacle better); Pinnacle and the paired Poisson values use the 3,630 matches with odds (2025-26: 210 of 380); mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate
same mean, CI = t interval over the 10 per-season differences (treats seasons as the sampling unit)

poisson_minus_pinnacle_closing_logloss_m.how: paired difference vs Pinnacle closing; Pinnacle and the paired Poisson values use the 3,630 matches with odds (2025-26: 210 of 380); mean over the 10 test seasons of the per-season mean log-loss (nats/match); 95% CI from 2000 match-resampling bootstrap replicates per season, averaged across seasons replicate by replicate

poisson_minus_pinnacle_between_season_sd.how: SD of the 10 per-season Poisson - Pinnacle pre-match differences; chi-square CI; Cochran Q = 13.4 on 9 df (p = 0.15) against the per-season bootstrap SEs

poisson_minus_pinnacle_detectable_gap_pe.how: 2.80 x per-season paired bootstrap SE (5% two-sided test, 80% power); est = mean over seasons, 'ci' = range over the 10 seasons (a design quantity, not a confidence interval); mean SE = 0.0089

poisson_minus_pinnacle_detectable_gap_10.how: 2.80 x SE of the 10-season mean difference, SE = sqrt(sum SE_s^2)/10; exact design quantity, no interval

seasons_poisson_beats_pinnacle_prematch.how: count of test seasons with Poisson - Pinnacle pre-match < 0 (point estimate; none is significant on its own unless its CI excludes 0); 'ci' = binomial 2.5/97.5% quantiles at the observed share

best_half_life_days.how: half-life (null = no decay) with the lowest mean log-loss over the 10 test seasons among 4 x 2 configs; selected on the test seasons themselves. Best on the first five seasons: hl=365d|gamma=season|promoted=relegated; on the last five: hl=365d|gamma=one|promoted=relegated. 'ci' = shortest and longest half-life (days) whose paired log-loss difference from the best has a 95% CI including 0 (same gamma mode; no decay within: False)

decay_gain_vs_no_decay.how: paired log-loss difference no decay - best half-life (positive = decay helps), all 3,800 test matches; 2000 paired match-bootstrap replicates

season_gamma_minus_one_gamma.how: paired log-loss difference season-specific gamma - one gamma at the best half-life (negative = season gamma better); 2000 paired match-bootstrap replicates

promoted_rule_range_all_matches.how: log-loss of the worst rule (league_avg) - best rule (shrink50) over all 3,800 test matches; paired bootstrap, 2000 replicates; rules: mean of relegated / league average / 50% shrink; prior SD 0.3 on log scale

promoted_rule_range_promoted_matches.how: same difference on the 1080 test matches involving a promoted team; paired bootstrap

logloss_2024_25_match_only.how: rolling Poisson (hl=365d|gamma=season|promoted=relegated); parameters treated as fixed, 2000 resamples of the 380 test matches

logloss_2024_25_param_and_match.how: 200 replicates: resample every season up to 2024-25 with replacement (within season), redo all 45 rolling refits incl. the promoted-team targets, score the resampled test matches; percentile CI. Includes parameter, imputation and match sampling uncertainty; width ratio to match-only = 1.01

logloss_2024_25_param_only_sd.how: SD over the training-set bootstrap of the log-loss on the fixed 380 test matches (parameter + imputation only); 'ci' is the percentile interval of that log-loss re-centred on the point estimate
